name.description: Name of the environment; must match the file name

description.description: What the environment is for, e.g. the production system

variables.description: Variables of this environment, used as ${NAME}; they override those of project.yaml

secretStore.description: Where ${secret:NAME} reads secrets from in this environment, instead of secretStore of project.yaml: env (environment variables) or local (the local secret store, not available yet)
